name: Venomancer: one Pheromone per Venomancer on a recipient (#4264)
contract: #4264: Spider (803177), Beetle (803651) and Toxic (707689) Pheromones are three different spells of family 35 with no spell_group, so the server let the same Venomancer keep all three on one ally. The reporter expects one Pheromone per Venomancer per recipient, with a second Venomancer free to add a different one. The fix is a spell_group with stack rule 2 (exclusive from the same caster), as for Tinker Modules. Without it the first Pheromone stays when the next is cast; with it the newest replaces the older one of the same caster, while another Venomancer's Pheromone is untouched.

steps.label: Let spawn and level scaling settle
BASELINE: Spider Pheromones is applied by v
SETUP: Beetle Pheromones is applied by v
DISCRIMINATING: casting Beetle removed v's Spider Pheromones
SETUP: Toxic Pheromones is applied by v
DISCRIMINATING: casting Toxic removed v's Beetle Pheromones
SETUP: a second Venomancer applies a different Pheromone on the same ally
The first Venomancer's Toxic Pheromones is untouched by the other Venomancer
